preservation_rules.PRESERVED_HISTORICAL_PATH: receipts, evidence, fixtures, reports, ledgers, snapshots and dated folders describe what already happened
preservation_rules.PRESERVED_CLOSED_CHANGE_RECORD: task records and registry entries in a terminal state (RETIRED, CLOSED, COMPLETED, RELEASED, SUPERSEDED, MERGED)
preservation_rules.PRESERVED_DATED_RECORD: dated session, census and observation records
preservation_rules.PRESERVED_HASH_LINE: lines carrying a commit or content hash are retained evidence
preservation_rules.PRESERVED_HASH_BOUND: bytes pinned elsewhere (control/worker-registry.json and its terminal mirror) or inputs of reusable-task invocation manifests whose manifest_hash resident requests pin
preservation_rules.PRESERVED_RETAINED_EVIDENCE: machine-readable supersession evidence and the 2026-10-07 classifier/disposition artifacts
preservation_rules.PRESERVED_LEGACY_CONSTANT: the single LEGACY_ constant through which a reader still accepts a pre-migration name
preservation_rules.OPEN_WIRE_CONTRACT_OWNED_BY_MASTER_RECOR: route and configuration names that master-records/orchestration and resident deployments own; renaming them here alone would break the call path
preservation_rules.OPEN_CONTEXTUAL_REWRITE_REQUIRED: no deterministic rule applies; needs line-by-line rewording

path_encoding_note: Entries whose file name embeds a 40-hex content id carry path_template plus content_id instead of path.
